source.title: Living Luster's Lightbelt — original Wowhead Disenchanting / Looter table
source.author: Wowhead Looter (aggregated anonymous player submissions)

notes: New previously-unrecorded original item-specific cumulative Looter source. Source-displayed 116 item disenchanting operations, Refulgent Crystal display row 1 of 3 has 69 positive item-material occurrences. The indexed table strips individual output links/quality tiers, so Refulgent Crystal output item ID and rank remain null; row ordinal is NOT a verified rank. Source reports no stack-distribution numbers: total units, per-hit min/max, zero-inclusive per-material histograms and global zero-output counts remain unknown; missing table rows never imply zero outcomes. Input gear epic cloth waist (Priest), first introduced in patch 11.0.0, but collection patch, bonus/ilvl variant, skill, specialization, exact date and game build are unknown. PTR web-page label is not the sample's patch. Sample is cumulative and may be mirrored across Live/PTR pages, so use this source URL as original and do not treat other versions as independent cohorts. No Resourcefulness or refund basis reported (disenchant one gear per operation); not a live Retail eligibility or gold-EV claim.
